stage: pre-integration isolated trial (?detailTrial=c01c02), code base de2dc1a + bench/rig fixes of this round

device.gpu: ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M5 Pro
device.display: frame times are capped by a 120 Hz vsync; 8.3 ms is the floor

method: tools/acceptance/run-trial.pw.js + run-trial-stress.pw.js with tools/acceptance/page-harness.js; each shot waits for both trial tiles to reach 'ready' (or 'idle' for release), settles 1.5 s, then __gz.bench samples 150 frames with automatic quality adaptation paused

faultCycles.eachCycle: 404 injection -> error with fallback visible and no asset; retry -> ready; base -> cached; detail -> ready

releaseAtFarView.note: sampled after warm-up, instant switching, clicked flights, fault cycles and A/B; geometry count grows 692->720 during the first flights then stays flat through fault cycles and A/B, while detail meshes and cached assets return to 0. Other distance caches (tree LOD, traffic) are not isolated by this counter; re-checked on the integrated default scene.

verdict: passes integration gate for loading, fallback, release and switching on this device; frame times are equal between base and detail at the same cameras within vsync resolution
limitations: single desktop GPU; not a phone or integrated-GPU result
short sessions (minutes), not a long-duration memory test
heights, porch depth and uncovered faces remain estimated/unknown; acceptance is not metric verification
